entities.name: Mutaib bin Abdulaziz Al Saud

entities.summary: Mutaib bin Abdulaziz Al Saud was a senior member of the Saudi royal family and since the death of his half brother Prince Bandar in July 2019 was the oldest surviving son of King Abdulaziz.
